Definition: Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Bela means "destruction." The name is shared by several bearers: A king of Edom; First son of Benjamin; A son of Ahaz, a Reubenite; One of the five cities of the plain which was spared at the intercession of Lot, and received the name of Zoar. It turns up in Genesis 14:8, Genesis 36:32 and 1 Chronicles 8:1.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Bela marks real ground in God's story, not a made-up setting.
